about_the_game:
The battle for the Empyrean Realm has begun. A ruthless enemy commander has launched a full-scale invasion, searching for the Empyreal Core, an ancient secret technology hidden deep within the realm. As the last line of defense, deploy a variety of military, economic, and support sites, upgrade your arsenal, and adapt your strategy to withstand relentless enemy attacks. Unlock powerful new skills and abilities, craft specialized ammunition, and trade rare items and enemy drops on the market to turn the tide of battle in your favor!

Strategic Tower Defense with Modern Military Warfare

Command a variety of defensive and support structures, from sniper towers and missile launchers to research centers and power plants. Each site plays a vital role in your defense:

  • Military: Engage enemies directly with a mix of classic and advanced structures

  • Economic: Generate valuable resources to fund construction and upgrades

  • Power: Maintain a reliable energy grid to support advanced structures

  • Support: Research cutting-edge technologies to enhance your defenses

Upgrade, Defend, Control

  • Customizable Sites: Upgrade and modify key components of each site to tailor your defense to any situation

  • Diverse Enemy Waves: Defend against ground, naval, and airborne enemies and bosses

  • Player Abilities: Call in airstrikes, deploy protective bubble shields, and even manipulate the battlefield with lightning storms and blizzards

War Across 27 Regions

Fight your way through forests, deserts, snowy mountains, and warn-torn cities as you defend key locations across the realm. Each region presents new challenges, tougher enemy forces, and evolving battlefield conditions.

Story-Driven Campaign

Experience a dynamic military conflict with a progressing storyline, featuring four key characters who guide you through the campaign with tactical insights and battlefield banter. The war isn't just about survival - it's about stopping the enemy commander before he unlocks the power of the Empyreal Core.

Can you defend the realm and prevent its secrets from falling into enemy hands?

name: Empyrean Defense

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD R9 290
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: A modern warfare tower defense game where you build, upgrade, and customize defenses to hold back an enemy invasion. Learn abilities and skills, craft advanced ammunition, and gather resources on the battlefield to strengthen and expand your defense.
